name: agenticom
description: Publish, read and share planning specs on agenticom — pages composed of the planning kit, versioned and reviewed in the open.

interface.longDescription: agenticom hosts the specs a planning session produces — pages composed of the planning kit's components — as versioned artifacts with reviews and comments. This plugin connects the agent to the agenticom MCP server as the signed-in person, so it can read the publishing flow and the kit's documentation, upload a draft and see what the build checked, publish it as the next version, and read and manage the projects, workspaces and artifacts the person can reach.
capabilities: Read the publishing flow and the kit documentation
Upload a spec draft and see what the build checked
Publish a draft as the next version
Read specs, versions, reviews and comments
defaultPrompt: Publish this spec to agenticom as a draft.
List the specs in my agenticom home.
What changed in the latest version of this agenticom spec?

positive.prompt: Which agenticom account am I connected as?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the signed-in person's name and email.
Lists the specs the person owns, most recently updated first.

positive.prompt: How do I publish a spec on agenticom?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the publishing-on-agenticom topic and explains the draft, check and promote steps.

positive.prompt: Open my agenticom spec called Onboarding and summarise it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the spec and summarises its latest version.

positive.prompt: Upload this spec to agenticom as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the source and reports the build's answer: the failed checks, or a private draft link.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tel Aviv tomorrow?
Write me a poem about autumn.
Show me my Google Docs from last week.

review.commerce_description: agenticom does not sell anything through this plugin and processes no payments in it.
